name: Il suo volto era una maschera di sangue
source:
During the celebrations of an old folk festival, a man is found dead inside the village church. All the inhabitants have something to hide.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/mascheradisangue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个古老的民间节日正在庆祝之中，有人却发现一名男子死在村里的教堂内。村中每个人都有事隐瞒。

［摘自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/mascheradisangue]Itch.io[/url]］
